audit_kind: Fresh goal: full current-file first pass, then alternate-route/source/invariant final pass
notation: Jackson SI units and phasor/source conventions explicitly preserved.

dimensions.mathematics_physics: All statements, subparts, intermediate equations and claimed limits retraced in the current section; see per-problem records.
dimensions.calculation_implementation: Entire current chapter script read. Independent integral/ODE/symbolic routes, domains, tolerance scales, singular endpoints and numerical convergence examined; script executed with warnings as errors.
dimensions.resources: Standalone bounded calculations and local owned output files. No persistent server, external service or process lifecycle in chapter script; solver failure assertions and exceptions propagate.
dimensions.performance: No optimization target. Finite quadrature/mesh/root limits examined for accuracy and feasibility; observed suite completed successfully. Formal universal numerical certification is not claimed.

candidate_findings.candidate: Energy variation integrates field inside trial conductors.
candidate_findings.evidence: Equilibrium field there is zero; dropping that nonnegative variation energy yields the exterior identity. Boundary flux condition and fixed charges still cancel the cross term.

candidate_findings.candidate: Quoted 10.23 reference disagrees with finite-grid flux.
candidate_findings.evidence: Book printed p.55 gives 10.23 as a numerical reference. Current primal/dual bounds straddle it; finite-grid flux is explicitly only an estimate. No contradiction verified.

problems.independent_final_pass: Rechecked isolated versus grounded charge accounting; pillbox normal and absolute field magnitude have consistent SI units.

problems.first_pass: Orthogonal-coordinate metric determinant and localized Gaussian normalization.
problems.independent_final_pass: Integrated the delta with the actual volume Jacobian; excluded singular coordinate charts explicitly.

problems.first_pass: Shell, line and disk delta measures in all requested coordinates.
problems.independent_final_pass: Reintegrated total charge and checked that the spherical disk representation adds no point charge at the origin.

problems.first_pass: Integrated r^n density, enclosed charge and radial field for n>-3.
problems.independent_final_pass: Small-sphere flux tends to zero even for singular but integrable densities; surface-conductor limit and external field agree.

problems.first_pass: Radial Laplacian of screened potential and its distributional point term.
problems.independent_final_pass: Continuous charge integrates to -q, the point flux supplies +q; hydrogen length parameter agrees with the 1s density.

problems.independent_final_pass: Dimensions F versus F/m, thin gaps and large outer-radius limits checked against field integrals and current numerical results.

problems.first_pass: Two-wire voltage from logarithmic potentials and geometrical mean radius.
problems.independent_final_pass: Compared small-radius approximation with exact bipolar capacitance at three refinements; errors decrease in the stated regime.

problems.first_pass: Field-energy integrals for every geometry versus Q^2/(2C).
problems.independent_final_pass: Rechecked neutral-system external fields, energy positivity and the factor one half using direct integrals.

problems.first_pass: Mechanical force at fixed charge and at fixed voltage with source work.
problems.independent_final_pass: Legendre energy gives the same attractive force after Q=CV; treating battery work with the wrong sign would fail this comparison.

problems.independent_final_pass: Regular harmonic expansion leaves only the l=0 center value; the full averaging ball must be charge-free.

problems.first_pass: Normal flux-tube area change and principal curvatures.

problems.first_pass: Green reciprocity including conductor surface normals and infinity.

problems.first_pass: Applied reciprocity to point charge between planes.
problems.independent_final_pass: New independent one-dimensional Poisson jump solve reproduces both induced charges and their sum -q.

problems.first_pass: Dirichlet Green symmetry, Neumann asymmetry and gauge adjustment.
problems.independent_final_pass: Fresh textbook equations (1.42)-(1.46) checked; new explicit ball kernel has symmetric arguments and vanishing boundary value.

problems.first_pass: Thomson fixed-charge energy difference and vanishing cross term.

problems.first_pass: Old charge distribution as admissible trial when neutral conductor is added.
problems.independent_final_pass: New concentric neutral-shell field-energy calculation gives a strictly positive removed energy, consistent with the nonincrease theorem.

problems.first_pass: Dirichlet variational bound and zero-boundary variation.
problems.independent_final_pass: New nontrivial radial variation has exactly zero cross integral and positive squared-gradient integral.

problems.first_pass: Single-layer representation and fixed-charge quotient stationarity.
